s.note: the little cake marked eat me
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 125g self-raising flour. Spoon into a mini muffin tin and bake at 175C for 12 minutes. Cool, ice white and pipe eat me on top in pink icing. Watch out for growing spurts.

s.note: the Queen of Hearts and her painted red roses
s.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into hearts and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until puffed. Cool, split in half and fill with strawberry jam and whipped cream. Dust the tops with icing sugar. Keep a close eye on them, someone always steals the tarts.

m.note: the Queen's croquet game played with flamingos
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 2 sliced leeks. Stir in a spoon of flour, 250ml chicken stock, 200ml cream and thyme and simmer until thick. Pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Sandwich with strawberry jam, ice in pastel colours with icing sugar and add candles. Happy unbirthday to everyone.

d.note: the little bottle marked drink me
d.how: Brew 4 earl grey tea bags in 500ml boiling water and stir in a spoon of honey. Cool, then mix with 500ml lemonade and a squeeze of lemon. Pour over ice in mismatched teacups. Drink me, but not too much at once.
